# --- stage declarations from tools/aio/stages/mod_aio_darknoon.txt (fojo-authored), re-slugged by slugmod ---
# ==========================================================================
# mod_darknoon_stages
#
# DERIVED WORK - NOT ORIGINAL. This mod is a repackaging of
# PD_AIO_March_2026/mod_dark_noon for the pd-fojo modloader. It carries the
# Dark Noon multiplayer arena:
#   - the stage declaration below
#   - level data: bgdata/, Ump_setupmp7Z, P* props
#   - the textures that stage uses
#
# Deliberately left out of this mod:
#   - 127 C* character models -> see mod_aio_characters / mod_gex_characters
#   - 38 G* gun and hand models -> byte-identical AIO baseline, not stage content
#
# The source modconfig declares NOTHING - it is comments only. Upstream runs
# this level by shipping bg_mp7 under the plain vanilla name, which collides
# with mod_gex_stages' own bg_mp7 and resolves by roster order. Every file
# here has been through slugmod, so that cannot happen: this mod's bytes are
# its own and the block below is what makes the level reachable.
#
# The block names the level rather than picking a stage row. There is no
# STAGE_EXTRA row labelled for Dark Noon, so it takes whichever free one the
# allocator gives it, recorded under [MpStageSlots] in pd.ini.
#
# Every credit line in the source modconfig.txt is reproduced below
# unaltered. The level work is the original author's.
# ==========================================================================

# --- begin credits and revision history carried over from
# --- PD_AIO_March_2026/mod_dark_noon/modconfig.txt, verbatim ---
# Dark Noon Mod for All in One Mod v3
# Author: Jonaeru / Atari-Dude

# Dark Noon by MRKane

# Revision History
# v2: Replaced Skedar and Dr. Carroll Models last version by Wreck. Thank you so much, Wreck.
#     Merged Atari-Dude mod files (April 10, 2025)
# v3: Merged Atari-Dude mod files (July 20, 2025)
# --- end carried-over credits ---

stage "darknoon" {
  bgfile "bgdata/bg_mp7_aio_darknoon.seg"
  tilesfile "bgdata/bg_mp7_tiles_aio_darknoonZ"
  padsfile "bgdata/bg_mp7_pads_aio_darknoonZ"
  mpsetupfile "Ump_setupmp7_aio_darknoonZ"
  kind mp
  arenaname "Valley"
  # lifted 2026-09-20 (lift-out/lift.py rule 3c): langbank lang.c:198 (STAGE_TEST_MP7 -> LANGBANK_MP7); allocation pdmain.c:153 (STAGE_TEST_MP7); env env.c:160 (STAGE_TEST_MP7 nofog, 'Valley')
  langbank MP7
  allocation "-ml0 -me0 -mgfx200 -mvtx200 -ma400"
  env {
    near 10
    far 14096
    distfade 0 0 0
    sky 0x110015
    suns none
    clouds 0 3000 0 0x3a1100
    water 0 0 0 0x000000
    cloudsheight 0
    transparency 0
  }
}
